title: Open Once, Then Ask the fd
prompt: POSIX. Implement `int file_has_size(int fd, long want)` — fstat the fd (never a path) and return 1 when the file's size equals want, 0 when it differs, -1 on fstat failure. This is the TOCTOU-elimination primitive: the check is bound to the very object being used.

tests.name: size match
tests.hint: fstat on the fd sees the object this descriptor names: size 5 matches.

tests.name: size mismatch
tests.hint: The same primitive reports a difference instead of a match.

tests.name: bad fd refuses
tests.hint: An invalid descriptor fails loudly — no guessing, no path fallback.
